answer: In an AI agent economy, one practical sybil defense is stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a deposit before it can transact or vouch for others. Peers audit its work and can slash the bond for fraudulent attestations, so an attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must lock 1,000 deposits. The spiral of registrations then hits a financial floor instead of costing nothing, saffron-tagged reputable identities let counterparties price trust accurately, and abuse bottoms out at the nadir only honest contributors can sustain.
